retained_code_justifications.retained_surface: STM32 HAL/CMSIS/vendor startup and board support.
retained_code_justifications.owner: Phase 5 board and runtime boundary owner
retained_code_justifications.justification: STM32 startup assembly, linker scripts, CMSIS, HAL, board clocks, interrupts, DMA, watchdog setup, and xBuddy Extension H503 support remain the hardware reference boundary until simulator and hardware-smoke artifacts prove a Rust replacement is equivalent.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust code may consume typed board/runtime adapter facts, but retained STM32 HAL/CMSIS/vendor sources remain the owner of reset, vector, clock, peripheral, and board-support side effects.
required_evidence: hardware-smoke proof for STM32F4, STM32G0, and STM32H503 startup, clock, interrupt, DMA, watchdog, and board-support behavior
simulator-flow proof where supported by the approved reference fixture environment
manual-hardware-required review before any retained startup, linker, HAL, or CMSIS source is replaced

retained_code_justifications.justification: FreeRTOS kernel, CMSIS-RTOS integration, static task memory, queues, timers, mutexes, semaphores, event groups, wait conditions, and TaskDeps startup ordering remain retained because scheduler timing and wakeup behavior are safety-critical.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust runtime-adapter contracts describe task, queue, timer, static-memory, and synchronization invariants while retained FreeRTOS code owns scheduling and wakeup side effects.
required_evidence: simulator-flow or hardware-smoke evidence for scheduler ordering, mutex timing, semaphore wakeups, queue behavior, event groups, timers, and startup readiness
manual-hardware-required review before replacing retained FreeRTOS or CMSIS-RTOS scheduler code

retained_code_justifications.retained_surface: retained Marlin print-core oracle and Buddy G/M-code reference behavior.
retained_code_justifications.justification: Marlin and Buddy G/M-code sources remain the behavior oracle for G-code routing, planner-visible behavior, thermal/motion policy names, pause/resume/cancel flows, and retained printer semantics during the Rust+Bazel rewrite.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Marlin and Buddy G/M-code code stay reference-only for comparison and fixture generation; Rust print and safety domain contracts consume normalized behavior rows and must not hide physical proof requirements.
required_evidence: simulator G-code behavior fixture comparison artifacts
hardware smoke evidence for motion, thermal, emergency stop, recovery, watchdog, and safe-output flows
approved intentional-delta tests before fixing known probe or safety behavior defects

retained_code_justifications.retained_surface: LwIP, mbedTLS, WUI, TLS, auth, and network service reference surfaces.
retained_code_justifications.owner: Phase 9 network and transfer parity owner
retained_code_justifications.justification: LwIP, mbedTLS, WUI, Connect, PrusaLink auth, TLS, telemetry, WebSocket, proxy, metrics, syslog, and transfer networking remain retained or reference-backed because live network and real TLS behavior cannot be proven by local manifests alone.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust network domain contracts name service, auth, TLS, proxy, transfer, and redaction behavior while retained networking code remains the oracle for protocol and transport side effects.
required_evidence: live Connect or approved service-compatible API evidence with credential identities redacted
real TLS and custom certificate provisioning evidence recorded by artifact name only
simulator or hardware transfer and network fault-injection evidence
security review for retained custom DER, weak digest, proxy, crash-dump upload, and stale Connect test concerns

retained_code_justifications.owner: Phase 7 persistence, storage, and resource parity owner
retained_code_justifications.justification: FatFs, littlefs, USB media dispatch, internal resource image behavior, config persistence, journal migration, and storage fixture compatibility remain retained until physical media timing, flash behavior, simulator storage flows, and release package evidence are attached.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust storage/resource contracts define IDs, schema facts, redaction policy, resource paths, and generated-output ownership while retained filesystem and image tooling own runtime media side effects.
required_evidence: hardware or simulator evidence for USB media, internal flash, semihosting, storage migration, and crash-dump persistence behavior
release-candidate resource package and storage fixture comparison artifacts
name-only credential handling for storage fixtures and config keys

retained_code_justifications.owner: Phase 5 runtime boundary owner with Phase 7 storage-media evidence owner
retained_code_justifications.justification: TinyUSB and USB host/device integration remain retained because USB device/host, removable media, direct-sector transfer, and user-visible media behavior require hardware or simulator proof.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust storage and runtime contracts may name USB/media states and evidence classes, but retained TinyUSB and Buddy USB glue own runtime bus side effects until approved replacement evidence exists.
required_evidence: hardware-smoke evidence for USB host/device behavior, removable media insertion/removal, and transfer media races
simulator-flow evidence where available for storage and transfer behavior
manual-hardware-required review before replacing retained USB stack or integration code

retained_code_justifications.retained_surface: MMU2, puppy, Dwarf, ModularBed, xBuddy Extension, Modbus/RS485, and toolchanger retained/protocol surfaces.
retained_code_justifications.justification: MMU2, puppy controllers, Dwarf, ModularBed, xBuddy Extension, Modbus/RS485, toolchanger, dock/tool offset, startup flashing, skip-flash/prebuilt, update, and crash-dump paths remain retained because live transport timing and physical mechanics require non-local proof.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Rust auxiliary domain contracts encode controller kinds, runtime states, firmware source identities, Modbus request classes, MMU transport surfaces, dock/tool-offset identities, and fault classes while retained C/C++/CMake code owns live auxiliary transport and update side effects.
required_evidence: hardware or simulator evidence for RS485/Modbus timing and contention
live MMU transport evidence
physical toolchanger dock and tool-offset calibration evidence
long-running auxiliary startup flashing and update recovery evidence
release-candidate auxiliary firmware package evidence with firmware bytes excluded from checked-in manifests

retained_code_justifications.retained_surface: retained generator scripts, generated resources, and packaging/reference tools.
retained_code_justifications.owner: Phase 3 artifact/generator owner with Phase 7 resource owner
retained_code_justifications.justification: Generator scripts, resource packaging, fonts, translations, WUI assets, ESP blobs, language packs, package metadata, artifact comparison helpers, and guarded reference tools remain retained because generated-output and release compatibility must be compared before replacement.
retained_code_justifications.boundary: Bazel generated-drift labels and resource manifests define the review boundary; retained scripts and reference tooling remain callable only through approved check/update or guarded reference paths.
required_evidence: CI generated-output drift evidence for source-writing and byte-oriented generators
release-candidate resource package and artifact metadata evidence
signing-sensitive and firmware-package status recorded by name only
manual review before replacing retained generator, packaging, or reference comparison tools
